name: sorceress_generate_music
description: Generate a song (vocal or instrumental) from a description or custom lyrics/style (Suno) and save the mp3(s) into the project (default assets/sorceress/audio). Returns ~2 variations. Flat 10 credits, charged only on success. Waits for completion and returns the saved file path(s).

prompt.description: Simple mode: a description of the song. Advanced (customMode): the actual lyrics. Leave empty for auto-lyrics/instrumental.

customMode.description: false = Simple (describe the song). true = Advanced (provide lyrics + style + title). Default false.

model.description: Suno version: V5_5 (default), V5, V4_5PLUS, V4_5, V4.

style.description: Advanced only: musical style/genre (e.g. "epic orchestral, cinematic").
